# strava-run-coach

> Stdlib-only Python running coach: Strava history in (Strava MCP JSON, REST
> sync, or the bulk-export CSV) -> Daniels VDOT race prediction, CTL/ATL/TSB
> fitness tracking, a graded debrief of every run, plans built around the
> athlete's race and week, weekly check-ins, long-horizon trends, .ics export,
> and a self-contained HTML dashboard. `coach.py` is the single entry point;
> no pip installs, ever.

Key facts: all athlete numbers live in `config.json` (`coach.py init
--from-mcp` writes it from the Strava profile, zones and history; falls back to
`config.example.json`); state lives at `config.home()` (code dir, the plugin
data dir, or `STRAVA_COACH_HOME`); `enrichment.is_real_run()` is the single
filter for "is this a real run"; the engine stays in miles and metres and
`units.py` renders `athlete.units`; Strava MCP list summaries carry no heart
rate, so `get_activity_performance` (HR + laps) and `get_activity_streams`
payloads are saved under `data/mcp/perf/` and `data/mcp/streams/` and merged
by `coach.py ingest`; `coach.py status --json` says what is still missing;
never commit anything under `data/`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): quickstart, command table, Use-with-Claude flow
- [Coaching](docs/COACHING.md): how the coach talks; verify before escalating
- [Methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md): the named, cited models (VDOT, TSS,
  CTL/ATL/TSB, two-stream load, pace-matched decoupling, the grade, ACWR caveats)
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module map, state home, data contracts
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): working notes for AI agents (commands, hard rules)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): tests, stdlib-only rule, style

## Agent surface

- [strava-coach-analyze skill](.claude/skills/strava-coach-analyze/SKILL.md):
  the entry point: MCP pull + status-driven ingest + one-question setup + report
- [review-run skill](.claude/skills/review-run/SKILL.md): debrief one run
- [weekly-review skill](.claude/skills/weekly-review/SKILL.md)
- [race-forecast skill](.claude/skills/race-forecast/SKILL.md)
- [build-plan skill](.claude/skills/build-plan/SKILL.md)
- [Plugin manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): install via
  `/plugin marketplace add abrarhaque-code/Strava-Run-Coach`
- [MCP config](.mcp.json): official Strava MCP at https://mcp.strava.com/mcp

## Code entry points

- [coach.py](coach.py): CLI router (full/brief/review/fitness/forecast/metrics/
  trends/week/scenario/plan/note/status/ingest/analyze/reconcile/dashboard/
  sync/init)
- [config.example.json](config.example.json): every tunable, including the
  `plan` block and the dashboard theme tokens
- [status.py](status.py) / [onboarding.py](onboarding.py): what the coach has;
  config from the Strava MCP
- [mcp_adapter.py](mcp_adapter.py): Strava MCP JSON -> cache (list + performance
  + streams merge, `fetch_plan`)
- [post_run_review.py](post_run_review.py): `review()` dict + `render()`
- [plan_generator.py](plan_generator.py) / [plan_layout.py](plan_layout.py):
  the plan and its 7-day layout
